ResearchProjectDef.label: EDD trip mine
ResearchProjectDef.description: An indoor defensive device highly effective against infantry. It is suited for corridors, doorways, and other narrow routes enemies must pass through. Hostiles crossing it will have a very bad time, and it requires very few resources to produce.

ResearchProjectDef.label: automated sentry systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock compact automated sentry turrets for close defensive coverage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: automated field engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock automated maintenance arms for early defensive network support. These systems repair damaged friendly buildings and suppress nearby fires with directed firefoam bursts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: medium-caliber automated weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock medium-caliber automated turret platforms for stronger perimeter firepower.

ResearchProjectDef.label: high-cycle weapon engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: An experimental weapon technology built around the coordinated operation of feed, firing, and active cooling systems, and the core foundation of the Vanguard 20mm cannon project. It allows a turret to gradually raise its feed and action cycle speed during sustained fire, continuously compressing shot intervals and cooldown time until output climbs rapidly, the system reaches its load limit, and the weapon is forced into shutdown.\n\nThe Vanguard project is infamous on several frontier worlds. Local garrisons widely issued it specialized hollow-point incendiary rounds against massed infantry assaults with little protection. Personnel struck by this ammunition often suffered catastrophic tissue tearing and burn trauma, making the turret one of the most feared weapons in colonial suppression operations.

ResearchProjectDef.label: automated grenade projection systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock versatile grenade turrets, making real-time battlefield control possible. Multifunction grenade turrets can fire fragmentation, smoke, EMP, and stun grenades.

ResearchProjectDef.label: heavy anti-armor artillery
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock heavy automatic anti-armor turrets designed to defeat armored threats with high-caliber fire.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gun-launched missile adaptation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock missile feed systems that adapt heavy cannon turrets to fire guided gun-launched missiles.

ResearchProjectDef.label: directional energy barriers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock directional energy barriers that project one-way defensive shield fields.

ResearchProjectDef.label: high-speed belt feed systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock high-rate automatic cannon systems for heavy defensive networks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced 20mm ammunition
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock linked high-speed belt feeders and specialized 20mm ammunition options for compatible cannon turrets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rocket-propelled ammunition
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop launch and feed standards for compact rocket-propelled defensive ammunition.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tactical missile systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock automated tactical missile turrets for concentrated long-range defensive strikes. The vertical missile silo (WIP) is currently in testing.

ResearchProjectDef.label: high-energy capacitor arrays
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock high-capacity defensive capacitor arrays for pulsed energy weapons. These arrays store large amounts of power and provide the stable energy reserve your heavy energy weapons require to operate.

ResearchProjectDef.label: magnetic rail acceleration theory
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock experimental magnetic acceleration and high-energy beam weapon platforms.

ResearchProjectDef.label: high-energy beam confinement theory
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock experimental laser emitter turrets that discharge capacitor energy into confined high-energy beams.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sonic suppression technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock sonic shock emitters that release a close-range stunning pulse for emergency defensive control.

ResearchProjectDef.label: defensive network protocols
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock global fire-control consoles for coordinating Defensive Network Expanded turrets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: remote ballistic correction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock close-range aiming extension arrays that improve the engagement envelope of linked defensive turrets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: target identification
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock tactical marker towers that maintain target locks, expose hostile weakpoints, reveal invisible enemies, and increase enemies' chance to be hit. These systems are especially useful when building layered defensive positions.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Smart Ballistic Control Theory
ResearchProjectDef.description: Through micro-guidance components, ballistic data links, and real-time target prediction, projectiles can still correct their flight trajectory after leaving the firing platform. This theory advances traditional fire control from "calculating the hit position" to "continuously controlling the hit process."

ResearchProjectDef.label: multi-source target analysis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock Tri-Eye targeting arrays that fuse multiple sensor feeds to mark up to three hostile targets at once.

ResearchProjectDef.label: low-altitude autonomous navigation theory
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock Hunter drone auto-deployment platforms, Hunter drone packs, and Companion Attack Drone packs for compact autonomous defensive patrols.

ResearchProjectDef.label: high-altitude loitering platform theory
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock HAD-09 Ghoul drone bomber bays for deep-strike high-altitude unmanned bombing operations.

ResearchProjectDef.label: uplink support
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock uplink support consoles for direct remote fire-control operations through an integrated battlefield interface.

ResearchProjectDef.label: heavy hover platform theory
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock HFSV-40 Landwhale heavy ground-effect fire support vehicles.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tactical simulation theory
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock tactical simulation tables for training and battlefield planning.
